answer_1.quote: Personalized Dialogue Generation (PDG), a critical method for capturing and responding to users' emotions and preferences in dialogues, aims to model role bases according to given roles or personas, thus generating role-relevant responses to meet users' individual needs.

answer_2.quote: We divide the automatic evaluation methods into three categories in order to evaluate and model the diversity, consistency, and coherence of the generated dialogues.

answer_4.quote: We extract 100 data points (histories, responses, and role data) and engage three well-educated annotators to rank the responses from various models and normalize them into specific scores ranging from 0 to 1 to save costs.
answer_4.guideline: Our evaluation centers on readability, diversity, consistency, and coherence, prompting evaluators to rank 6 options for the five excellent model-generated responses and the factual responses.
